work.author: Augustine of Hippo
work.description: Augustine's second and longer answer to Januarius on the observances of the Church, in twenty-one chapters and thirty-nine numbered sections. Its chapter 14 expounds the four dimensions of Ephesians 3:18 as the four members of the Cross. A locus is chapter.section or the section number alone.
work.title: Epistula 55 ad Ianuarium
